name: Homestuck
source:
Homestuck is a webcomic written, illustrated, and animated by American author and artist Andrew Hussie. The comic centers on a group of teens who play a beta version of an upcoming computer game.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Homestuck]Wikipedia[/url]].
translation:
《Homestuck》是一部网络漫画，由美国作家兼艺术家安德鲁·赫西 (Andrew Hussie) 撰写、绘制插图并制作动画。该漫画以一群青少年为中心，他们正在玩即将推出的电脑游戏的测试版。

[来自[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Homestuck]维基百科[/url]]。
